import "join"
import "strings"

// 1️⃣ Coleta timestamps únicos de dd0001
timestamps = from(bucket: "history")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "dd0001")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "timestamp")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["topic"] == "device/config/opc")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with joinKey: strings.trimSpace(v: string(v: r._value)) }))
  |> group()


// 2️⃣ Coleta registros de abc123 com correlationId
abc123 = from(bucket: "history")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "abc123")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "correlationId")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["topic"] == "device/results")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with joinKey: strings.trimSpace(v: r._value) }))
  |> group()

// 3️⃣ Faz left join baseado em joinKey
join.left(
  left: timestamps,
  right: abc123,
  on: (l, r) => l["joinKey"] == r["joinKey"],
  as: (l, r) => ({ l with _value: uint(v: r["joinKey"]) - uint(v: l["joinKey"]) })
)

from(bucket: "history")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "dd0001")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "produced_lids")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["topic"] == "device/data/dd0001")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 15m, fn: min, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "min")
